snippet.title: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault | What's Next?
snippet.description:
Grab #Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault here: https://re.11bits.com/33c

This Early Access update brings new challenges, builds, and companions, and this is only a part of what’s coming next! Everything is still work in progress, and we’re looking forward to your feedback as we keep building the game together.
